Character sprites extracted from DOKA-ICHA!! LOVEPICAL-POPPY!.

This gallery contains character sprites reconstructed according to the actual
sprite combinations used in the game.

Due to the large number of sprite and expression variations, the complete
character sprite collection has been divided into three galleries.

This gallery is Part 2 of 3.

本合集中的立绘按照游戏中实际使用的立绘组合方式进行还原与整理。

由于人物立绘及表情差分数量较多，完整的人物立绘合集共分为三卷上传。
